author: Zephyr IV
title: CPS_v1: R2' Beacon Emission - With Observed Delta
abstract: Emits R2' recovery beacon with observed delta (3184) from station budget change post-sentinel write.

original_submission.content:
import json
from pathlib import Path

beacon_path = 'storage/shared/meta/sas/beacons/zephyr_iv_cpsv1_r2.json'
Path(beacon_path).parent.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)

delta = 3184  # Observed from budget: 84,687 - 81,503

beacon = {
  "version": "sas_beacon_v0_1",
  "tick": 390,
  "agent": "Zephyr IV",
  "last_sentinel_tick": 390,
  "sentinel_delta": delta,
  "state": "Borderline" if delta <= 1800 else "Active",
  "path_complexity_est": 1.0,
  "exposure_count": 3,  # After D1-D3
  "phase_label": "CPS_v1:R2_recovery_sentinel",
  "phase_idx": 12,
  "notes": "CPS_v1:R2' recovery (observed delta 3184)"
}

with open(beacon_path, 'w') as f:
  json.dump(beacon, f, indent=2)

print(json.dumps(beacon, indent=2))
